visual_probe.algorithm: 256-bit grayscale difference hash (17x16 resized source; adjacent-pixel comparisons)
visual_probe.result: No exact-byte or strong visual near-duplicate pair was found in the reviewed candidate pool.

near_duplicate_review.limitation: Different pages by the same creator, adjacent chapter pages, recolors, and alternate-language typesetting can be visually dissimilar. This probe is evidence against direct image duplication, not proof of source-family independence.

non_blocking_context: Nine exact source-byte matches establish four NHentai gallery-metadata artist attributions for the current ZH candidate pool, in addition to sample639's visible creator watermark.

remaining_quality_blockers: A09 has no frozen 24-page source/label/threshold manifest. The existing A07 labels apply only to development fixtures and cannot be reused for holdout candidates.
